etymologies.etymologyHTML: From gang +‎ -ster. First attested in 1884.

definitions.definition: A member of a criminal or street gang.
A member of a professional criminal organization; a racketeer.
To act like a gangster; to commit street crime or run a racket.
(African-American Vernacular, slang) Characteristic of a gangster; (especially) admirable and audacious.

quote.citation: 2011, Isaiah Washington, Lavaille Lavette, A Man From Another Land: How Finding My Roots Changed My Life, New York, N.Y. […]: Center Street, →ISBN, page 121:
quote.text: I looked at my team and thought, "Damn, now that was the most gangster move I have ever seen in my life. I think we just strong-armed a government official in Sierra Leone!"

quote.text: Sampling is the most gangsta shit ever. Im finna steal yo life's work and make it into trap music

definitions.definition: (African-American Vernacular, slang, Internet slang) On friendly terms; cool.
